reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two distinct bodies of work: the disorder-to-order transition via a dwell period from P1/P4/P5/P10/P12, and the elemental nucleation gap/kinetic trapping mechanism from P2/P6/P13. It links these by proposing that a brief intermediate dwell at a lower temperature can overcome the segregation caused by disparate nucleation thresholds, a mechanistic connection that none of the passages explicitly makes. The application to noble metal–based HEA nanoparticles with more than five elements in a rapid heating/cooling regime is a new combination of these ideas.
